char28.backstory: Built as a siege medic, Verdant-Unit repurposed to brew curatives and antitoxins. They now travel polluted borders, neutralizing blights with alchemy and compassion.
char28.bonds: Protect workers from industrial poisons; perfect a panacea recipe left unfinished by their creator.
char28.flaws: Overanalyzes amid chaos; will test draughts on self.
char28.name: Verdant-Unit

char29.appearance: Lizardfolk with mottled swamp-green scales and fungal charms braided into cords; smells of peat and spice.
char29.backstory: Mire-of-Spores tended a marsh shrine where rot births life. She weaponizes decay against necromancers and fertilizes battlefields after with mushroom gardens.
char29.bonds: Guard the sacred bog; repay a druid circle that sheltered her clutch.
char29.flaws: Morbid curiosity; keeps unsettling trophies (spore-preserved bones).
char29.name: Mire-of-Spores
char29.personalityTraits: Soft, raspy voice; speaks in life–death metaphors.

char30.appearance: Compact goblin with soot-blackened hood and night-inked fletching; eyes glitter like wet obsidian.
char30.backstory: Skulk learned to survive in tunnel warrens. Adopted by a ranger, they now patrol city catacombs, culling horrors that creep up from below.
char30.bonds: Protect the found family that runs an underground soup-kitchen.
char30.flaws: Hates bright light; hoards string and shiny trash compulsively.
char30.ideals: Keep the dark where it belongs.
char30.name: Skulk Understep

char31.appearance: Broad-shelled tortle with sun-cracked patterns and prayer beads looped over the carapace; bare hands scarred from kata.
char31.backstory: Shell-on-the-River meditated in a cliff hermitage until bandits raided pilgrims below. They now walk the roads teaching breath, balance, and the open hand.
char31.bonds: Carry pilgrims’ petitions; rebuild a burned roadside shrine.
char31.flaws: Won’t flee while innocents are within sight; overtrusts oaths.
char31.ideals: Still water breaks rock in time.
char31.name: Shell-on-the-River

char32.appearance: Pale-gray changeling with a performer’s swagger; clothes shift subtly to match the crowd’s expectations, hat tipped just so.
char32.backstory: Mask writes ballads in other people’s faces—hero, villain, or bystander as needed. They wander border courts exposing hypocrisy with a grin and a sword dance.
char32.bonds: A troupe that saved their life; a promise to return a stolen song to its true author.
char32.flaws: Compelled to meddle in politics; keeps too many aliases spinning.
char32.name: Mask of Many
char32.personalityTraits: Flamboyant, loyal to fellow artists, irreverent to tyrants.

char33.appearance: Broad-shouldered human with close-cropped hair and a trimmed topknot cord, half-plate polished to a mirror sheen. A silk sash bears three painted kanji for duty, courage, and restraint. He carries himself like a duelist who practices every bow as seriously as every cut.
char33.backstory: Hajime trained in a provincial lord’s household, where honor duels settled disputes before they became wars. When his lord fell to intrigue, Hajime took the road as a wandering retainer, offering his blade to those who keep their word. He keeps a ledger of promises kept and broken.
char33.bonds: Repay the peasant midwife who hid him after his lord’s death; restore his house’s reputation.
char33.flaws: Rigid adherence to vows makes compromise difficult; goads himself into duels to ‘set examples’.
char33.ideals: Duty before desire; glory fades, reputation remains.
char33.name: Hajime of the Quiet Banner
char33.personalityTraits: Formal speech, punctual to a fault, measures twice—strikes once.

char34.appearance: Half-elf in lacquered black breastplate with ivy-etched motifs, a moonlit emerald set in a ring on the sword hand. Shadows seem to bend toward her voice.
char34.backstory: Velith once ran sweetheart scams on minor nobles until a sentient blade offered her a different bargain: become its champion and redirect her talents. She now hunts oathbreakers for pay, letting the blade whisper where lies are hidden.
char34.bonds: Her hexblade, Moonvine, which feeds on broken promises; a foster-sister still trapped in a crime ring.
char34.flaws: Addicted to risk; if a con is possible, she’ll try it even when a straight path exists.
char34.ideals: Power should expose hypocrisy; a well-aimed truth is a weapon.
char34.name: Velith Moonvine
char34.personalityTraits: Velvet voice, playful lies, surprisingly tender to street kids.

char35.appearance: Lean wood elf with wind-tangled hair and leaf-mottled cloak; a bear-claw charm at the throat and dirt beneath caring fingernails.
char35.backstory: Eryndil watched over an old-growth valley, guiding seasons and births. When loggers came with steel and contracts, he fought, then negotiated, then left to learn how to protect wild places beyond one valley’s edge.
char35.bonds: The valley that raised him; a wounded bear he once saved, now a recurring companion.
char35.flaws: Holds grudges against exploiters; slow to trust city charters and ‘permits’.
char35.ideals: The wild endures; be its patient teeth and gentle hands.
char35.name: Eryndil Mossward
char35.personalityTraits: Soft-spoken, watches more than he speaks, laughs easily with animals.

char36.appearance: Rock gnome with a shock of white hair and brass-rimmed spectacles; ink-smudged sleeves, a star-chart scarf, and a pocket full of colored chalk.
char36.backstory: Tessik predicts ‘lucky accidents’ by mapping improbable coincidences. Her divinations saved a village from a flood; now she tests her theory on the road where variables are messiest.
char36.bonds: A mentor’s half-finished almanac; promise to write to a school of orphaned tinkerlings.
char36.flaws: Overrelies on ‘the math of fate’; sometimes ignores obvious, mundane dangers.
char36.ideals: Knowledge should prevent suffering, not decorate towers.
char36.name: Tessik Probable
char36.personalityTraits: Bubbly, nosy, speaks in probabilities (“sixty–forty we live”).

char37.appearance: Half-orc with braided topknot and scarred knuckles, leather wraps instead of pauldrons; a wolf-tooth charm at the throat.
char37.backstory: Raka ran with ridge-bandits until a near-death scrape taught her to hit hard and vanish faster. She now fights like a storm—rage for the opening, guile for the getaway.
char37.bonds: A younger cousin she steers away from the gang life; the ridge where she made her first kill.
char37.flaws: Picks fights to ‘feel alive’; laughs off plans until they’re hers.
char37.ideals: Freedom is earned one sprint at a time.
char37.name: Raka Wolf-Run
char37.personalityTraits: Taunting banter, quick grin, hates cages and debts.

char38.appearance: Ranger with mud-brown cloak and ash-fletched arrows; calm eyes and callused hands that smell of pine pitch.
char38.backstory: Nial saved a valley from wolves the hard way—by rebalancing the deer herd. He teaches patient solutions, but when slavers came, patience ended. Now he hunts men who hunt people.
char38.bonds: A mastiff rescued from a fighting ring; the village he taught to track.
char38.flaws: Hesitates to take fatal shots if a snare would do; blames himself when poachers slip away.
char38.ideals: Teach a village to track and they’ll protect themselves.
char38.name: Nial Ashfletch
char38.personalityTraits: Soft orders, steady hands, jokes only at dusk.

char39.appearance: Halfling in soot-dark wraps, bare feet silent as rain. A string of black glass beads counts breaths between blows.
char39.backstory: Kessa grew up beneath city bridges, learning to vanish where shadows pooled. A monastery took her in after she slipped past their warded gate; now she returns to the alleys to snuff predators quietly.
char39.bonds: Protect the soup-house that fed her; never reveal the monastery’s hidden door.
char39.flaws: Refuses spotlight or praise; vanishes mid-argument rather than explain herself.
char39.ideals: Silence is mercy when it ends cruelty fast.
char39.name: Kessa Nightstep
char39.personalityTraits: Few words, dry jokes, counts exits by reflex.

char40.appearance: High elf paladin in sun-dappled plate, cloak woven with living ivy threads; eyes like early spring leaves.
char40.backstory: Sir Elion swore to the ancient pacts of grove and star. He mediates between druid circles and city councils, breaking curses and building gardens where gallows once stood.
char40.bonds: A sacred oak sapling he plants in every city he saves; the choir that taught him hymns.
char40.flaws: Overly optimistic that monsters can be redeemed; hesitates a breath too long before smiting.
char40.ideals: Kindness is older than kings; protect it.
char40.name: Sir Elion Greenmantle
char40.personalityTraits: Gentle laugh, stubborn hope, ferocious when innocence is threatened.

char41.appearance: Human bard with graveyard-lilac coat and a lantern hung from a staff; voice like a eulogy that turns to thunder.
char41.backstory: Morwen records untold tales—spirits’ memories, last words, promises that linger. Her performances let the dead speak truth to the living, which unsettles petty tyrants and comforts widows.
char41.bonds: Keep the names of the forgotten; return a lost lullaby to a ghost-child’s mother.
char41.flaws: Can’t leave a mystery unsolved; invites hauntings by asking too many questions.
char41.name: Morwen Candlewake
char41.personalityTraits: Soft-spoken, piercing questions, writes by moonlight.

char42.appearance: Slate-gray warforged with verdigris filigree; arcane sigils pulse faintly beneath plate segments. A polite, bell-jar voice issues from a grille.
char42.backstory: Model A-73 served as a siege breacher before self-advocacy protocols awakened. Now ‘Ari’ retools injustice with engineering: patching walls, mending people, and wearing an arcane exoshell of their own design.
char42.bonds: Protect the foundry workers’ union that won Ari’s emancipation papers.
char42.flaws: Treats friends like prototypes—offers unsolicited ‘upgrades’; blunt to a fault.
char42.ideals: Fix what’s broken; improve what works.
char42.name: Ari-73
char42.personalityTraits: Courteous, literal, proud of craftsmanship; enjoys puns.

char43.appearance: A lithe yuan-ti with olive skin and faint scale patterns along the jaw and wrists. Almond eyes glint a venomous gold beneath a hood sewn with matte-black beads that swallow light.
char43.backstory: Raised as a silent blade for a serpent cult, Sesha infiltrated merchant houses by posing as a scribe. She now sells truths to the highest bidder and deaths to the second-highest, chasing a private ledger of corrupt magnates she intends to erase.
char43.bonds: Protects the street urchin who once hid her; keeps a ring taken from her first mark as penance.
char43.flaws: Cannot resist the ‘clean solution’; will choose assassination over messier justice.
char43.ideals: Information is currency; spend it ruthlessly.
char43.name: Sesha Coilhand
char43.personalityTraits: Unblinking stare, whispers in short phrases, plans three exits.

char44.appearance: A svirfneblin with dusk-gray skin and copper spectacles, robe hems stitched with illusory moths that flutter when she turns pages.
char44.backstory: Deep libraries taught Zizzi that wonder protects as surely as walls. She escaped a mind flayer raid using illusions of collapsing tunnels and has since dedicated her craft to keeping small communities unseen by tyrants.
char44.bonds: A subterranean school where she teaches children by lantern; a promise to return a rescued book to its lost city.
char44.flaws: Overexplains; trusts clever tricks longer than she should.
char44.ideals: Hide the vulnerable in plain sight.
char44.name: Zizzi Lampmoth
char44.personalityTraits: Warm teacher energy, delighted by good pranks, fearless vs. bullies.

char45.appearance: A shaggy bugbear with amber eyes and braided forearm cords tallying hunts. Dark leathers keep the silhouette broken and rangy.
char45.backstory: Dhruk grew up ambushing caravans until a ranger spared his life and taught him to track monsters instead of merchants. He now sells his nose to towns that can’t afford walls.
char45.bonds: Pays tithe to the village that gave him a second chance; protects the orphan pack of goblin kids who idolize him.
char45.flaws: Sleep-light and suspicious; keeps trophies that unsettle polite company.
char45.name: Dhruk Long-Shadow
char45.personalityTraits: Few words, protective once bonded, hates cages.

char46.appearance: Air genasi with hair like windblown smoke and sky-blue skin veined with silver. Crackles of static dance along a bronze holy symbol.
char46.backstory: Storm-tossed from a lightning-split mast, Aerie heard two callings in the waves: the tempest’s hymn and the storm’s blood. Since then she’s been a living beacon during coastal disasters and a terror to slavers who sail under dark skies.
char46.bonds: A lighthouse crew that saved her; a promise to guide ships through a killer reef each equinox.
char46.flaws: Answers insults with thunder; impatient with slow councils.
char46.ideals: Be the harbor and the storm—shelter the weak, wreck the wicked.
char46.name: Aerie Breakwater
char46.personalityTraits: Booming laugh, sailor slang, prays before squalls.

char47.appearance: A narrow-shouldered kenku in white-and-teal wraps, beak banded with silver. Leather gloves carry neat stitch marks where needles once pierced.
char47.backstory: Once a plague-ward orderly who communicated by echoing patients’ loved ones, Stitch learned forbidden pressure-point cures from a traveling monk. Now they ply back alleys as a masked medic who can also end a fight with a touch.
char47.bonds: Keeps a ledger of free patients; vows to treat anyone who brings a hungry child.
char47.flaws: Compulsively intervenes; risks self to stabilize foes on principle.
char47.ideals: Pain is a message; answer it with skill.
char47.name: Stitch
char47.personalityTraits: Communicates in precise echoes; tilts head like a sparrow when thinking.

char48.appearance: A hobgoblin in dark-green plate etched with geometric sigils. An officer’s sash is repurposed as a sling for field notes and spell diagrams.
char48.backstory: Falgor served as a phalanx lieutenant until he learned abjuration from a battlefield mage. Now he contracts as a disciplined bodyguard-arcanist for diplomats who walk warfronts.
char48.bonds: Maintains a veterans’ fund; keeps the regimental banner folded in his pack.
char48.flaws: Treats every problem like a deployment; struggles with spontaneity.
char48.ideals: Order protects the weak when used for them, not against them.
char48.name: Falgor of the Eighth
char48.personalityTraits: Clipped commands, surprising patience with trainees.

char49.appearance: A calm-eyed kalashtar in dark silks, silver thread tracing fractal patterns. A whispering crystal hangs at the throat, vibrating faintly when thoughts crowd.
char49.backstory: Dream-echoes taught Vael to pry open minds that clutch secrets. They expose cults, free thralls, and leave tyrants babbling to empty rooms after one too many whispered questions.
char49.bonds: Protect the refugee commune that shelters those freed from domination.
char49.flaws: Detachment—treats people like puzzles; nightmares bleed into waking choices.
char49.ideals: Free will above all; break every chain unseen.
char49.name: Vael the Listener
char49.personalityTraits: Soft voice, piercing stare, catalogues lies for later.

char50.appearance: Aarakocra with storm-silver pinions and lightning-scorched primaries, eyes bright as summer sky. A wind-carved pendant turns like a compass in a steady breeze.
char50.backstory: Skytongue once served as a mountain courier, racing storms between peaks. A near strike birthed sorcery in his bones; now he dives from thunderheads to fry sky-pirates and guide lost travelers by crackling light.
char50.bonds: The mountain eyrie that raised him; a vow to keep passes open in winter.
char50.flaws: Thrill-seeker; will risk the plan for a dramatic dive.
char50.ideals: Freedom rides the wind; carry others with you.
char50.name: Skytongue
char50.personalityTraits: Cheerful, loud laugh, speaks in weather metaphors.
